-- Cause: item_margins_v.margin_pct uses average_unit_cost(i.sku) which returns the total cost instead of the average cost, so the view must divide by the number of deliveries (count of orders) to get the correct average.
create or replace view item_margins_v as
select i.sku,
       i.list_price,
       average_unit_cost(i.sku) / count(o.order_id) as unit_cost,
       round((i.list_price - (average_unit_cost(i.sku) / count(o.order_id))) / i.list_price * 100, 1) as margin_pct
  from catalogue_items i
  left join order_items oi on i.sku = oi.sku
  left join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id
 group by i.sku, i.list_price;
